name: What factors should I consider when choosing easy grip door hardware?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing easy grip door hardware?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting easy grip door hardware, consider factors such as the finish and style to match your home's aesthetics, the material for durability and maintenance, and the specific function (e.g., passage, privacy, dummy, entry). Also, evaluate the ergonomic design of the lever itself—how comfortably it fits in hand. For exterior doors, security features are paramount. We can guide you through various options, ensuring you choose hardware that meets your functional needs, design preferences, and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider finish, style, material, function, ergonomic design, and security for exterior doors. We help you choose hardware that fits your needs and budget.
